name: Pont Marie
text: The Pont Marie (French pronunciation: [pɔ̃ maʁi]) is a bridge which crosses the Seine in Paris, France. The bridge links the Île Saint-Louis to the quai de l'Hôtel de Ville and is one of three bridges designed to allow traffic flow between the Île Saint-Louis and the Left and Right banks of Paris. The Pont Marie links the Right Bank and is the counterpart of the Pont de la Tournelle which is built along the same line but serves to connect the Île Saint-Louis with the Left Bank.

depictions.name: Pont Marie
depictions.text: The Pont Marie is a bridge across the Seine in Paris, France. It connects the Île Saint-Louis to the northern bank of the Seine.
